title: Fantasy Team Budget Efficiency
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=f1fantasy:team round_name=* team_points=* budget_spent_m=*
| eval points_per_million=round(team_points/budget_spent_m,2)
| sort - points_per_million
| table round_name team_points budget_spent_m points_per_million
description: Calculates F1 Fantasy points scored per million of budget spent for each race round.
value: Budget efficiency exposes whether you are overpaying for marquee drivers who under-deliver.
implementation: Export fantasy team snapshots with `team_points` and `budget_spent_m` after each lock deadline.
visualization: Bar chart of points per million by race round.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how efficiently you spent your F1 Fantasy budget each race.
